features.name: Owned starship with buyable component upgrades that grant party bonuses
features.summary: The player buys a ship at a shipyard (stock depends on which faction's yard), then upgrades seven systems - drive, scanner, combat computer, troop capacity, medical bay, prisoner capacity, trade computer. The drive level speeds up map travel; the other levels add directly to the matching party skills (tactics, spotting, surgery/wound treatment, prisoner management, trade, ...). Ships can be sold back.
features.mechanics: menu:shipyard calls setup_spaceship_slots (651 stmts: 31 ship models stored as 'ship model' parties 248-278 with stats in party slots 250-271: name, description, price, base speed, max level per component) and rolls 7 offers from faction-specific ranges by $g_encountered_party. prsnt_starship buys a ship (reset_starship_slots_for_troop writes troop 0 slots 300 = ship model, 301-316 = current/max level per component). prsnt_ship_details shows current/max and get_component_upgrade_price per step; get_ship_sell_value prices a resale. Effects ride two engine callbacks: game_get_party_speed_multiplier (player party speed = ship base speed (party slot 255) x (100 + 10 x drive level)%, x3.33 at night / x2 by day, clamped 0-600; also patrols and fixed-speed templates) and game_get_skill_modifier_for_troop (adds component levels to skills 11, 15, 9, 0 ... for the ship owner).
evidence: explain sw setup_spaceship_slots: callers menu:shipyard, game_start; party slots 250-271
dis sw game_get_party_speed_multiplier: troop 0 slot 300/315, party slot 255
dis sw game_get_skill_modifier_for_troop: troop slots 301-313 added to skills
sqlite slots sw troop 300-316 -> reset_starship_slots_for_troop, prsnt ship_details, get_ship_sell_value

features.name: Bank account with interest, 30-day loans, weekly pay-day from cash or account
features.summary: The player keeps credits in a bank account that earns interest every six days; fief taxes are paid straight into the account; he can take one loan at a time (1000/2500/5000) repayable within 30 days at a fixed rate; on pay day he chooses to pay troop wages from cash, from the account, or a mix.

features.name: Buildings that unlock special recruits (clone chamber, droid foundry, force temple, rancor pit)
features.summary: Besides the usual improvements, a player-owned minor planet (village) can build four special facilities; each one adds a recruitment option that sells a faction-appropriate elite or exotic troop (clone troopers, battle droids, force-sensitives, baby rancors) in limited numbers for a high price.
features.mechanics: Improvements are the Native village-improvement mechanism (get_improvement_details, build menus, party slot per building) extended with four new slots (e.g. party slot 135 = cloning chamber). Menu options on the minor-planet menu are gated by cf_minorplanet_recruit_*_cond (planet not hostile/looted: slot 35 not 1/2, slot 39 < 1, building slot == 1). minorplanet_recruit_volunteers_* adds min(stock slot 93, free party room, gold/price) of the troop chosen by the planet's faction (e.g. faction 16 -> troop 135, 17 -> 162, else 133), charges 150-170 credits each and empties the stock slot (-1); refresh happens on the normal volunteer refresh.
evidence: dis sw cf_minorplanet_recruit_clones_cond (party slots 35/39/135)
dis sw minorplanet_recruit_volunteers_force_sensitives (stock slot 93, faction-based troop, 150/170 credits)

features.name: Automatic faction patrols based at towns (levels 1-3)
features.summary: Selected towns and stations are patrol bases rated 1-3. Each base keeps two patrol parties of faction troops (15-50 men depending on level) that roam nearby, attack weaker enemies they meet, run home from much stronger ones, and never wander more than a day's ride from base.
features.mechanics: strig:90 (once, $total_init_done) -> init_patrol_faction_settings + init_patrol_bases (party slot 800 = level per base via init_patrol_settings). strig:87 (8 h) for bases with level 1-3 and party slot 54 < 0 -> patrol_base_spawn_patrols: count existing pt 13 parties with party slot 123 == base; spawn up to 2 with troop types from faction slots 83/84/85 (15/5, 20/10/5 or 25/15/10 men), set icon by faction, then decide_next_patrol_location. strig:91 (0.5 h) -> process_patrol_ai: within 5 map units of a hostile party, attack if own strength >= 1.25x theirs, else retreat to base if outmatched by 100+; leash: beyond 24 drop the chase, beyond 20 return to a random point near base, under 5 pick a new waypoint. strig:92 (2 h) -> process_patrol_maintenance / patrol_unit_maintenance (top-up, prisoners). Patrol speed in game_get_party_speed_multiplier depends on base level (105/100/110).
evidence: explain sw patrol_base_spawn_patrols / process_patrol_ai / process_patrol_maintenance (entry strig:87/91/92)
dis sw strig:90, strig:87
dis sw patrol_base_spawn_patrols (2 patrols per base, sizes by level)

features.name: Support units that resupply ammo and heal nearby allies in battle
features.summary: Soldiers fielding a power droid refill the ammunition of every friendly within 4 m every 30 seconds; a medical droid heals nearby friends; the player gets a message when he is the one helped.
features.mechanics: mst:lead_charge/t32 (every 30 s): for each living human agent wearing a power-droid 'armour' item (items 417-419) loop all same-team agents within 400 cm and agent_refill_ammo; for an agent wearing itm_fxseries_droid_armor (420) restore hit points to nearby friends; display 'A Power Droid refilled your ammo!' / 'A Medical Droid refilled some of your health!' when the player is a recipient. ti_on_agent_spawn (t33) gives droid-equipped agents a special walk animation (528).

explain sw mst:lead_charge/t32:conseq text 'A Power Droid refilled your ammo!'

features.name: Thrown grenades simulated by script (arc, gravity, bounce, fuse, blast)
features.summary: Thermal detonators are not ordinary missiles: when thrown, a script spawns a simulated projectile that flies on a gravity arc, trails particles, bounces off the ground, and after its fuse explodes, damaging everyone in the blast radius with on-screen damage feedback.
features.mechanics: itm_thermal_detonator1-3 ti_on_weapon_attack -> emit_projectile writes a free entry in a 256-row table kept on storage troops 975-991 (active flag, launch time, x/y/z, vx/vy/vz, particle system, owner). mst:lead_charge/t4 (every 0.05 s, condition block, 181 stmts) integrates every active row from $timer: position = p0 + v*t - g*t^2 (g = 981 units), bursts the row's particle system, tests ground contact against $ground_level / position_set_z_to_ground_level to bounce, checks agents in radius and calls agent_deliver_damage_to_agent ('Delivered {reg1} damage.' / 'Received %d damage.').
evidence: explain sw emit_projectile: callers itm_thermal_detonator1-3 [ti_on_weapon_attack]
dis sw mst:lead_charge/t4:cond stmts 0-38 (troop 975-982 slot table, gravity 981, particle burst)

features.name: Hotkey weapon mode switch (swap a weapon for its alternate form in place)
features.summary: Pressing a (rebindable) key swaps the wielded weapon for its paired alternate version - e.g. a blaster between modes, a staff between forms - keeping its quality modifier, with a short message.
features.mechanics: mst:lead_charge/t29 (on $toggle_weapon_key) reads the wielded item; if item slot 6 holds an alternate item id it finds that item in the player's equipment slots 0-3, replaces it with the alternate (troop_set_inventory_slot + same modifier) and starts a one-line mission conversation (start_mission_conversation) - a trick that forces the engine to re-equip the agent from the troop's inventory immediately.
evidence: dis sw mst:lead_charge/t29:conseq (item slot 6, troop_set_inventory_slot, start_mission_conversation)
global sw toggle_weapon_key used by 29 mission-template conditions

features.summary: In battle the player can press a key to heal 20 HP if he carries an injector and at least one capsule (each use consumes a capsule); other hotkeys give a jump-pack leap (animation, not usable mounted), crouch, and a death-camera after falling.

features.name: In-game key assignment for mod abilities

features.name: Ranged troops step back from melee
features.summary: Shooters (archer-class agents with ammo, not ordered to charge) try to keep their distance: they back off 3 m, and keep backing off while an enemy is within 3 m, releasing control once enemies are more than 10 m away.
features.mechanics: Every 0.3 s in 12 battle templates ranged_avoid_melee loops class-1 agents holding a non-melee weapon (outside items 758-814) with ammo and team movement order not 'charge'. If agent slot 4 == 1 (in avoid mode): closest enemy (get_closest3_distance_of_enemies_at_pos1) > 10 m -> agent_clear_scripted_mode, slot 4 = 0; <= 3 m -> scripted destination 3 m backwards. Else (not in avoid mode) -> scripted destination 3 m backwards and slot 4 = 1.
evidence: dis sw ranged_avoid_melee (41 stmts)
explain sw ranged_avoid_melee: 12 callers [every 0.3s]

features.name: Upgrade-all with preview of who can be promoted
